Authored batch 17 end-to-end: 13 new draft items under `items/`, the two draft RG-1 pages [artin-induction-and-rational-characters.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/representation-theory/artin-induction-and-rational-characters.md) and [artin-induction-and-rational-characters-examples.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/representation-theory/artin-induction-and-rational-characters-examples.md), plus the batch contract [frontier-30-batch-17.proof-contracts.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-30-batch-17.proof-contracts.json) and updated notes [frontier-30-batch-17.notes.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-30-batch-17.notes.md).

One scaffolded claim was narrowed on purpose: `cor-cyclic-local-integrality-criterion` now states the source-backed denominator result `|G|x ∈ R(G)`, not the stronger unstated integrality criterion. The fixed-space corollary was also written in the form actually proved: injectivity on `R_Q(G)` plus the honest-representation interpretation of the coordinates. Source backing used here was [tom Dieck](https://www.uni-math.gwdg.de/tammo/d01.pdf), [Kramár](https://www.math.toronto.edu/murnaghan/courses/mat445/artinbrauer.pdf), [Kay Yang](https://www.math.toronto.edu/murnaghan/courses/mat445/kayyang.pdf), and the [Magma Schur-index example](https://docs.magma-maths.org/RepresentationTheory/CharactersOfFiniteGroups/schur-index.html).
